nevisinn_host.text: Welcome to the Nevis Inn. Walkers get the good seats, and muddy boots go by the door.
Ben Nevis is 1,345 metres, the tallest mountain in Britain. A weather observatory sat on the top from 1883 to 1904.
In Gaelic it is Beinn Nibheis. The view is magnificent on the handful of days the cloud lets you have it.

nevisinn_walker.text: Allow most of a day for the summit path. Carry a map, a hat, a torch and more snacks than you think. Then add a flask.
